explication: BrewUI is Homebrew’s native macOS package-management GUI. Users browse packages, inspect details, and manage installed packages and upgrades; the app also exposes configuration, diagnostics, command output, and read-only service status. The graph preserves those documented capabilities while distinguishing feature presentation, repository/data access, and command execution. Several feature implementations and their wiring were not sampled, so those relationships are shown only as unverified where useful; edges otherwise cite the README or sampled/indexed evidence.
